value.title: Christoph Willibald Gluck
value.snippet: Willibald (Ritter von) Gluck (/ɡlʊk/; German: [ˈkʁɪstɔf ˈvɪlɪbalt ˈɡlʊk]; 2 July 1714 – 15 November 1787) was a composer of Italian and French opera in the early

value.title: Jean Baptiste Colbert, Marquis of Torcy
value.snippet: conferences that resulted in the Treaty of Utrecht (1713) and the Treaty of Rastatt (1714) and was concerned with professionalizing the conduct of diplomacy.
